en: If you listened to me, you could be successful.
If it didn't rain, we could go to the sea.

tr: Eğer daha erken uyusaydın, sabah kalkabilirdin.
en: If you slept earlier, you could wake up in the morning.
If I were you, I would learn English.
If you were me, what would you do?
If you were me, where would you go?
If you won the lottery, how would you spend your money?

tr: Eğer çok paran olsaydı, nereyi ziyaret etmek isterdin?
en: If you had a lot of money, where would you want to visit?

tr: Daha fazla zamanım olsaydı, dünyayı gezerdim.
en: If I had more time, I would travel the world.
If he studied harder, he would pass the exam.

tr: Daha yakın yaşasalardı, onları daha sık görürdük.
en: If they lived closer, we would see them more often.

tr: Zengin olsaydım, büyük bir ev alırdım.
en: If I were rich, I would buy a large house.
If he knew the answer, he would tell you.
If it rained, we would cancel the picnic.
If you spoke French, you could work in Paris.
If we had a car, we could go to the beach.
If I didn't have to work, I could come with you.

tr: Utangaç olmasaydı, daha fazla arkadaş edinirdi.
en: If he weren't shy, he would make more friends.
If I knew her number, I would call her.

tr: Daha iyi futbol oynasaydı, takıma katılabilirdi.
en: If he played football better, he could join the team.

tr: Daha çok paramız olsaydı, yeni bir bilgisayar alabilirdik.
en: If we had more money, we could buy a new computer.
If he wore glasses, he would see better.
If they invited me, I would go.
If I felt better, I would come to the party.
If he wasn't afraid of dogs, he would own one.

tr: Hava daha güzel olsaydı, dışarı çıkabilirdik.
en: If the weather was better, we could go out.
If you tried harder, you would be successful.
If I had wings, I could fly.

tr: Uzakta yaşamasaydı, onu daha sık ziyaret ederdim.
en: If she didn't live far away, I would visit her more often.

tr: Bize yardım etselerdi, daha hızlı bitirirdik.
en: If they helped us, we would finish faster.
If I were you, I wouldn't do this.
If the teacher explained again, maybe I would understand.

tr: Yemek yapmayı bilseydim, akşam yemeğini ben yapardım.
en: If I knew how to cook, I would make dinner.
If we had a garden, we would grow vegetables.
If I didn't love chocolate, I would lose weight.
If you did sports, you would feel stronger.
If he didn't smoke, he would be healthier.

tr: İyi şarkı söyleseydi, bir gruba katılabilirdi.
en: If she sang well, she could join a band.

tr: Kar yağsaydı, bir kardan adam yapardık.
en: If it snowed, we would make a snowman.
If the train arrived on time, we wouldn't be late.
If I remembered her name, I would introduce you.

tr: Her şeyi unutmasaydı, daha düzenli olurdu.
en: If he didn't forget everything, he would be more organized.
If we spoke Spanish, we could talk to the locals.

tr: Daha iyi bir işim olsaydı, daha mutlu olurdum.
en: If I had a better job, I would be happier.

tr: Daha çok pratik yapsalardı, oyunu kazanabilirlerdi.
en: If they practiced more, they could win the game.

tr: Daha uzun olsaydı, bir manken olabilirdi.
en: If she were taller, she could be a model.
If I saw a ghost, I would escape.

tr: Ona bir şans verseydin, kendini kanıtlardı.
en: If you gave him a chance, he would prove himself.

tr: Bir evcil hayvanım olsaydı, ona iyi bakardım.
en: If I had a pet, I would take good care of it.

tr: Araba kullanmaktan nefret etmeseydi, bir araba alırdı.
en: If he didn't hate driving, he would buy a car.

tr: Hafta sonları çalışsalardı, daha çok para kazanırlardı.
en: If they worked on weekends, they would earn more money.

tr: Yorgun olmasaydım, daha çok ders çalışırdım.
en: If I weren't tired, I would study more.
If he listened to the advice, he wouldn't get in trouble.
If I had a chance, I would study abroad.
If you won the lottery, what would you do?

tr: Eğer bedava bir biletin olsaydı, nereye giderdin?
en: If you had a free ticket, where would you go?
If you needed help, who would you call?
If you had the chance, would you move abroad?

tr: Ona evlenme teklifi etseydin, kabul eder miydi?
en: If you proposed to her, would she accept?
If you were the president, what would you change?

tr: Dün yağmur yağsaydı, yürüyüşe çıkar mıydın?
en: If it rained yesterday, would you go for a walk?

tr: Daha çok çalışsaydı, sınavı geçer miydi?
en: If he studied harder, would he pass the exam?

tr: Çalışmak zorunda olmasaydın, bütün gün ne yapardın?
en: If you didn't have to work, what would you do the whole day?

tr: Onları davet etseydik, partiye gelirler miydi?
en: If we invited them, would they come to the party?
